paite: Huan Joshua in Israel nam tengteng Shekem ah asam-khawm a, Israel upate, a-intekpente, avaihawmte leh aheutute uh asamsak a; Pathian ma ah ahong kimusak chiat uhi.
heading: Joshua In Shekem Ah Mipite Kiang Ah Thu Agen

paite: Joshua in mi tengteng kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Na pipute uh nidanglai in lui khen lam ah ateng ua, Abraham pa leh Nahor pa Terah hialte leng, amaute'n pathian dangte nna asem uhi.
Na pu uh Abraham huai lui gal a pan ka pikhia a, Kanaan gam teng tawnsuak in ka pi a, asuante ka pungsak a, Isak ka pia hi.
Isak kiang ah Jakob leh Esau ka pia a; Esau tantuam ding in Seir tang ka pia a; Jakob leh atate Aigupta ah apaisuk uhi.
Mosi leh Aaron ka sawl a, alak ua thillamdang hih in Aigupta ka gawt a: huai khit in amaute ka hon pikhia hi.
Na pipute uh Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhia a, tuipi na hong tung ua; Aigupta mite'n na pipute uh kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite toh Tuipi San tan in anungdelh uhi.
Amau TOUPA asam ua, Aigupta mite toh na kikal uh amialsak bikbek a, amaute tuipi tuamsak in akhuhkhumsak a; Aigupta gam a ka thilhih na mit un amu a; gamdai ah sawtpi na teng uhi.
Jordan lui gal a om Amorte gam ah ka hon pi a; amau ahon dou uh. Na khut uah amaute ka hon pia a, agam uh na luahta uhi. Amau ka hon hihmangsakta hi.
Moab kumpipa Zippor tapa Balak ahong kisa a, Israel adou a; Beor tapa Balaam nou hon hamsiat ding in asamsak hi.
Himahleh Balaam thu ka ngaikhe kei hi. Huaiziak in nou ahon vualzawl zosopta hi. Huchi in akhut a pan ka hon hunkheta hi,
Jordan lui na kan ua, Jeriko khua na tungtou ua; Jeriko khomite'n hon na dou ua, Amorte, Perizte, Kanaante, Hitte, Girgaste, Hivte leh Jebuste toh; amau na khut uah ka hon peta hi.
Na ma uah tunpi ka sawl a, huai in na ma uah amau adelh a, Amorte' kumpipa nihte tan in leng. Himahleh na namsau un hiam, na thal un hiam in ahi kei hi.
"Na sepkhiak het louh uh gam leh na bawl het louh uh khopite ka hon pia a, huaite ah na teng ua; na suan louh uh grephuan leh olive huan a pan na ne uhi.
"Huaiziak in TOUPA laudan siam unla, chitak leh thutak in ama nna sem un. Na pipute un Lui gal leh Aigupta gam a, a-nna asep uh pathiante koihkhia unla; TOUPA nna sem un.

TOUPA nna sep hoih lou a na theih uleh tuni in kua nna ahia na sep ding uh, tel un. Na pipute un Lui gal a, a-nna asep uh pathiante hia, na luah uh gam a Amorte pathiante? Kei leh inkuante'n zaw TOUPA nna ahi ka sep ding uh," achi hi.
Mipite'n, "TOUPA Pathian paisan a, pathian dangte nna ka sep louh ding dan uh.
TOUPA i Pathian ngei ahi, i pipute toh Aigupta gam saltanna inn a pan hon pikhia a, i mitmuh a chiamtehna thupi taktak hih a, i paina teng leh mipi tengteng i nawk paisuakna ah leng hon vengbit hi.
TOUPA'N i ma ngei uah mi chih, huai gam a om Amorte ngei adelhkhe vek hi. Huaiziak in kou leng TOUPA nna ahi ka sep ding uh; amah lah ka Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in adawng uhi.
Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "TOUPA nna ná sem thei kei ding uh. Amah lah Pathian siangthou ahi ngal a. Mullit hat Pathian ahi a; na tatleknate uh leh na khelhnate uh angaidam kei ding hi.
TOUPA na paisan ua, namdang pathiante nna na sep uleh, na tung ua thil hoih ahih khit nung in ahong kihei dia, hon hih na in ahon hihmangthang ding," achi hi.
Mipite'n, Joshua kiang ah, "Hilou e, TOUPA nna ka sem kinken zaw ding uh," achi uhi.
Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "A- nna sep tum in TOUPA na telta uh, chih atheihpihtute noumau mah na hi uh," achi hi. Amau, "Theihpihtute ka hí uh,” achi uhi.
Amah mah in, "Huchi ahihleh na lak ua namdang pathian omte koihmang unla, na lungtangte uh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian lam ah awnsak un," achi hi.
Mipite'n Joshua kiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian nna ka sem ding ua, athu ka zui ding uh," achi uhi.
Huai ni in Joshua in mipite toh kikal ah thu akhung a, Shekem ah dan thuseh leh thuseh asehsak hi.
Joshua in hiai thu Pathian Dan Laibu ah agelh a; suang lianpi ala a, TOUPA Mun Siangthou chin a tosaw nuai ah aphut hi.

Joshua in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Ngai un, hiai suang i thu hon theihpihtu hi hen. TOUPA'N i kiang ua thu agen tengteng aza vekta hi. Huaiziak in na thu uh hon theihpihtu ahi ding hi, huchi lou in zaw Pathian na kitheihmohbawl kha ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Joshua in mipite atantuam gam chiat uah apaisakta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thilte khit in Nun tapa Joshua, TOUPA sikha kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi.
heading: Joshua Leh Eleazar Sihna

paite: Gaash tang mallam pang, Ephraim tanggam a amah tantuam gamgi sung Timnath-serah ah avuita uhi.
Joshua damsung leh amah khup a dam, TOUPA'N Israelte a dia thil ahih tengteng theihpih mite damsung in Israelte'n TOUPA nna asem uhi.
Israel suante'n Aigupta gam a pan Joseph guhte apuaktouh uh Shekem a Shekem pa Hamor tapate a pan Jakob in dangka zakhat a aleina mun ah avui ua; huai mun Joseph suante tantuam ahita hi.
Huan Aaron tapa Eleazar asi a; atapa Phinehas tantuam dia apiak Ephraim tang ah avui uhi.
